title: Selective INT4 TMR: theoretical memory cost and experimental evidence
interpretation: Protecting the complete first convolution requires 864 additional logical INT4 storage bytes, corresponding to approximately 0.0155 percent of the candidate-weight INT4 baseline. This policy covers the locations of all 12 independently sampled first-layer fault scenarios. Correction was verified under the single-faulty-replica assumption; whole-network reliability was not measured.
limitations: The memory analysis assumes ideal packed logical INT4 storage.
Actual PyTorch, hardware, metadata, and voting overheads are excluded.
All 12 sampled scenarios target the first convolution.
Only one real image was used.
No ground-truth mAP improvement was measured.
No runtime or energy overhead was measured.
One combined protected forward was performed, not 12 independent protected forwards.
The 12 scenarios are insufficient for general reliability estimates.
